title: Kiln server configuration v1
description: Canonical schema for kiln.toml. Sections and fields are optional because the typed loader supplies defaults; unknown sections and fields are rejected. Environment precedence and compatibility aliases are annotations, not TOML keys.

server.description: HTTP serving, scheduling limits, response metadata, and default thinking policy.

serving_profile.description: stable, experimental, or maintenance, case-insensitive. Process-lifetime policy; restart required.
serving_profile.x-kiln-validation: stable, experimental, or maintenance, case-insensitive. Process-lifetime policy; restart required.

deterministic.description: Enables deterministic tensor behavior and forces the effective concurrent decode width to one.
deterministic.x-kiln-validation: Enables deterministic tensor behavior and forces the effective concurrent decode width to one.

host.description: Must be non-empty. Binding beyond loopback exposes an unauthenticated inference and training API; use a trusted network or authenticated reverse proxy.
host.x-kiln-validation: Must be non-empty. Binding beyond loopback exposes an unauthenticated inference and training API; use a trusted network or authenticated reverse proxy.

request_timeout_secs.description: Must be greater than zero. Bounds a request, including model work and cleanup settlement.
request_timeout_secs.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. Bounds a request, including model work and cleanup settlement.

terminal_access.description: Process-lifetime access policy for the embedded interactive terminal. loopback_only enables it only for localhost or a loopback IP bind; enabled explicitly permits network binds; disabled closes it everywhere.
terminal_access.x-kiln-environment: KILN_TERMINAL (deprecated compatibility; boolean spellings map to enabled/disabled)
terminal_access.x-kiln-validation: loopback_only, enabled, or disabled. Compatibility boolean spellings are accepted from the environment. This capability can execute arbitrary code; changing it requires restart.

http_send_buffer_bytes.description: When set, 1024..=16777216. Applied to accepted sockets. Startup preflights the listener and rejects an OS read-back smaller than requested.
http_send_buffer_bytes.x-kiln-validation: When set, 1024..=16777216. Applied to accepted sockets. Startup preflights the listener and rejects an OS read-back smaller than requested.

stream_stall_grace_ms.description: 10..=2000. A request retaining KV state with no streaming delivery progress is selected for cancellation after this grace.
stream_stall_grace_ms.x-kiln-validation: 10..=2000. A request retaining KV state with no streaming delivery progress is selected for cancellation after this grace.

max_batch_tokens.description: 2..=65536. Combined decode-plus-prefill token budget for one batching-actor cycle.
max_batch_tokens.x-kiln-validation: 2..=65536. Combined decode-plus-prefill token budget for one batching-actor cycle.

max_prefill_tokens_per_cycle.description: 1..=65536. Independent new-prompt-token ceiling within the combined actor budget. The checked Strix Halo Vulkan development profile pins 128; 256 is not qualified for concurrent Vulkan serving.
max_prefill_tokens_per_cycle.x-kiln-validation: 1..=65536. Independent new-prompt-token ceiling within the combined actor budget. The checked Strix Halo Vulkan development profile pins 128; 256 is not qualified for concurrent Vulkan serving.

max_prefill_layers_per_cycle.description: 1..=1024. Number of transformer layers an in-flight prefill chunk may execute before yielding to decode.
max_prefill_layers_per_cycle.x-kiln-validation: 1..=1024. Number of transformer layers an in-flight prefill chunk may execute before yielding to decode.

max_decode_batch.description: auto, backend, and backend_policy all delegate to backend policy; an integer must be 1..=65536. Deterministic mode and max_batch_tokens may lower the final width. The Strix Halo Vulkan development-soak candidate sets 2; together with a prefill admission quantum of two, this yields four total active requests and admits an equal pair together.
max_decode_batch.x-kiln-validation: auto, backend, and backend_policy all delegate to backend policy; an integer must be 1..=65536. Deterministic mode and max_batch_tokens may lower the final width. The Strix Halo Vulkan development-soak candidate sets 2; together with a prefill admission quantum of two, this yields four total active requests and admits an equal pair together.

eval_mode.description: Enables deterministic eval-serving defaults, headers, adapter warnings, and transient-cache cleanup behavior. serve --eval-mode applies a typed override after environment resolution and wins without mutating process environment.
eval_mode.x-kiln-validation: Enables deterministic eval-serving defaults, headers, adapter warnings, and transient-cache cleanup behavior. serve --eval-mode applies a typed override after environment resolution and wins without mutating process environment.

debug_model_state.description: Enables trusted GET /v1/debug/model-state diagnostics without changing inference, cache, or eval semantics. server.eval_mode=true also enables the endpoint. The response contains model/configuration/runtime state but no prompt or user-message contents.
debug_model_state.x-kiln-validation: Enables trusted GET /v1/debug/model-state diagnostics without changing inference, cache, or eval semantics. server.eval_mode=true also enables the endpoint. The response contains model/configuration/runtime state but no prompt or user-message contents.

default_thinking_enabled.description: None preserves the model template default. Requests may override with chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. Without the canonical spelling, any presence of KILN_DEFAULT_NO_THINK, even a value such as 0, first selects false; the explicit KILN_DEFAULT_THINKING_ENABLED value is applied afterward and wins. When the canonical spelling is present, every present compatibility alias must resolve to the same boolean. There is no environment spelling that restores None.
default_thinking_enabled.x-kiln-environment: KILN_DEFAULT_THINKING_ENABLED (deprecated compatibility); KILN_DEFAULT_NO_THINK is a deprecated presence-only alias
default_thinking_enabled.x-kiln-validation: None preserves the model template default. Requests may override with chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. Without the canonical spelling, any presence of KILN_DEFAULT_NO_THINK, even a value such as 0, first selects false; the explicit KILN_DEFAULT_THINKING_ENABLED value is applied afterward and wins. When the canonical spelling is present, every present compatibility alias must resolve to the same boolean. There is no environment spelling that restores None.

default_thinking_budget_tokens.description: Integer values include 0, which closes thinking immediately. Case-insensitive unlimited clears a TOML limit back to None. Requests may inherit, replace, or explicitly disable the limit.
default_thinking_budget_tokens.x-kiln-validation: Integer values include 0, which closes thinking immediately. Case-insensitive unlimited clears a TOML limit back to None. Requests may inherit, replace, or explicitly disable the limit.

default_thinking_budget_ms.description: Integer values include 0. unlimited clears a TOML limit. The clock starts at the first decode candidate, after queueing and prefill. The first token or time limit reached forces the model's closing </think> sequence.
default_thinking_budget_ms.x-kiln-validation: Integer values include 0. unlimited clears a TOML limit. The clock starts at the first decode candidate, after queueing and prefill. The first token or time limit reached forces the model's closing </think> sequence.

fold_reasoning_into_content.description: Copies separated reasoning into content for compatibility clients. A request can override it.
fold_reasoning_into_content.x-kiln-validation: Copies separated reasoning into content for compatibility clients. A request can override it.

chat_performance_metadata.description: Default for chat response performance metadata; requests can override with include_performance.
chat_performance_metadata.x-kiln-validation: Default for chat response performance metadata; requests can override with include_performance.

chat_config_hash_metadata.description: Default for chat response config hashes; requests can override with include_config_hashes.
chat_config_hash_metadata.x-kiln-validation: Default for chat response config hashes; requests can override with include_config_hashes.

slow_request_warn_secs.description: 0 disables slow-request warnings; otherwise a request at least this old emits a structured warning.
slow_request_warn_secs.x-kiln-validation: 0 disables slow-request warnings; otherwise a request at least this old emits a structured warning.

shutdown_timeout_secs.description: Must be greater than zero. Hard ceiling for graceful drain before forced exit.
shutdown_timeout_secs.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. Hard ceiling for graceful drain before forced exit.

accelerator.description: Process-lifetime accelerator execution, Vulkan device selection, ROCm synchronization, and graph-cache policy.

kt_api_mode.description: auto, all, or disabled, case-insensitive. auto enables the qualified kiln-tensor adapter routes while leaving the experimental generic matmul and paged-KV routes inactive. all enables every adapter route; disabled forces legacy fallbacks. The two explicit modes require server.serving_profile = "experimental". The mode is resolved before accelerator execution, remains immutable for the process lifetime, and is reported with source attribution. Restart required.
kt_api_mode.x-kiln-validation: auto, all, or disabled, case-insensitive. auto enables the qualified kiln-tensor adapter routes while leaving the experimental generic matmul and paged-KV routes inactive. all enables every adapter route; disabled forces legacy fallbacks. The two explicit modes require server.serving_profile = "experimental". The mode is resolved before accelerator execution, remains immutable for the process lifetime, and is reported with source attribution. Restart required.

full_attention_score_budget_mib.description: 64..=2048. Immutable ceiling for exact full-attention materialized score and scratch geometry across CPU, CUDA, ROCm, Metal, and Vulkan model routes. ROCm online attention derives min(value, 1024) MiB while retaining fixed qualified 2048-query/4096-key tiles. Runtime memory observations remain fail-closed admission and reservation checks; they never resize the geometry or switch to smaller tiles during a request. Restart required.
full_attention_score_budget_mib.x-kiln-validation: 64..=2048. Immutable ceiling for exact full-attention materialized score and scratch geometry across CPU, CUDA, ROCm, Metal, and Vulkan model routes. ROCm online attention derives min(value, 1024) MiB while retaining fixed qualified 2048-query/4096-key tiles. Runtime memory observations remain fail-closed admission and reservation checks; they never resize the geometry or switch to smaller tiles during a request. Restart required.

vulkan_device_index.description: auto preserves automatic discrete-GPU preference and otherwise chooses the first enumerated Vulkan physical device. An integer strictly selects that zero-based Vulkan enumeration index. An unavailable index fails logical-device startup; it is never ignored or replaced with another device. The immutable selection is installed before Vulkan device creation and reported with source attribution. Restart required.
vulkan_device_index.x-kiln-validation: auto preserves automatic discrete-GPU preference and otherwise chooses the first enumerated Vulkan physical device. An integer strictly selects that zero-based Vulkan enumeration index. An unavailable index fails logical-device startup; it is never ignored or replaced with another device. The immutable selection is installed before Vulkan device creation and reported with source attribution. Restart required.

vulkan_validation.description: true requires server.serving_profile = "experimental" and enables VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation when the Vulkan instance is created. Startup fails if the layer is not installed. This is not mutable per request or dispatch. Restart required.
vulkan_validation.x-kiln-validation: true requires server.serving_profile = "experimental" and enables VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation when the Vulkan instance is created. Startup fails if the layer is not installed. This is not mutable per request or dispatch. Restart required.

cuda_kernel_profile.description: native_default or portable_fallback, case-insensitive. native_default preserves the fourteen CUDA backend routes that were enabled by default before consolidation; this name deliberately makes no current-hardware qualification claim. portable_fallback declines every owned route. The complete route set is installed before CUDA backend construction, immutable for the process lifetime, and reported with source attribution. Restart required.
cuda_kernel_profile.x-kiln-validation: native_default or portable_fallback, case-insensitive. native_default preserves the fourteen CUDA backend routes that were enabled by default before consolidation; this name deliberately makes no current-hardware qualification claim. portable_fallback declines every owned route. The complete route set is installed before CUDA backend construction, immutable for the process lifetime, and reported with source attribution. Restart required.

rocm_synchronization_mode.description: legacy_host_barriers or stream_ordered, case-insensitive. stream_ordered requires server.serving_profile = "experimental"; other profiles fail startup rather than silently weakening the request. Restart required.
rocm_synchronization_mode.x-kiln-validation: legacy_host_barriers or stream_ordered, case-insensitive. stream_ordered requires server.serving_profile = "experimental"; other profiles fail startup rather than silently weakening the request. Restart required.

rocm_strided_batched_matmul_mode.description: auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitive. auto applies the qualified gfx115x large-attention guard; enabled always permits the strided-batched route and disabled always uses per-row GEMMs. Either explicit route requires the experimental profile. Conflicting aliases, malformed values, and canonical-plus-alias inputs fail startup. Restart required.
rocm_strided_batched_matmul_mode.x-kiln-validation: auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitive. auto applies the qualified gfx115x large-attention guard; enabled always permits the strided-batched route and disabled always uses per-row GEMMs. Either explicit route requires the experimental profile. Conflicting aliases, malformed values, and canonical-plus-alias inputs fail startup. Restart required.

rocm_bf16_matmul_output_mode.description: auto, native_bf16, or f32_then_cast, case-insensitive. auto applies the qualified ROCm 7.2 shape guard; the explicit routes require the experimental profile. Conflicting aliases, malformed values, and canonical-plus-alias inputs fail startup. Restart required.
rocm_bf16_matmul_output_mode.x-kiln-validation: auto, native_bf16, or f32_then_cast, case-insensitive. auto applies the qualified ROCm 7.2 shape guard; the explicit routes require the experimental profile. Conflicting aliases, malformed values, and canonical-plus-alias inputs fail startup. Restart required.

rocm_kernel_profile.description: qualified, portable_fallback, or experimental_multiblock, case-insensitive. qualified installs forty-four of forty-five accelerated model/tensor routes, leaving only multi-block GDN prefill off, and retains thirty fixed correctness/bounded-work leaves. portable_fallback declines all forty-five accelerated routes while retaining the same safety behavior. experimental_multiblock enables all forty-five accelerated routes and requires server.serving_profile = "experimental". The complete 75-leaf policy is immutable after startup and governs backend/model dispatch, loading, forward/tape execution, W8 decode, training geometry, paged-attention specialization and splitting, concat assembly, finite checks, RMSNorm row tiling, and flash-attention forward/backward route selection and fixed tiling through Rust and C++ kernel boundaries. Retired per-kernel variables are not aliases. Restart required.
rocm_kernel_profile.x-kiln-validation: qualified, portable_fallback, or experimental_multiblock, case-insensitive. qualified installs forty-four of forty-five accelerated model/tensor routes, leaving only multi-block GDN prefill off, and retains thirty fixed correctness/bounded-work leaves. portable_fallback declines all forty-five accelerated routes while retaining the same safety behavior. experimental_multiblock enables all forty-five accelerated routes and requires server.serving_profile = "experimental". The complete 75-leaf policy is immutable after startup and governs backend/model dispatch, loading, forward/tape execution, W8 decode, training geometry, paged-attention specialization and splitting, concat assembly, finite checks, RMSNorm row tiling, and flash-attention forward/backward route selection and fixed tiling through Rust and C++ kernel boundaries. Retired per-kernel variables are not aliases. Restart required.

rocm_graph_mode.description: profile, disabled, warmup_then_eager, or lazy_capture_replay, case-insensitive. profile resolves to disabled under stable/maintenance and lazy_capture_replay under experimental. The two explicit non-disabled modes require the experimental profile. Restart required.
rocm_graph_mode.x-kiln-validation: profile, disabled, warmup_then_eager, or lazy_capture_replay, case-insensitive. profile resolves to disabled under stable/maintenance and lazy_capture_replay under experimental. The two explicit non-disabled modes require the experimental profile. Restart required.

rocm_graph_cache_entries.description: 1..=64. Bounds retained native graph entries in every product and embedding constructor. At saturation, admission reclaims idle owners first and then the minimum fair-LRU active entries while preserving one graph per active owner after the incoming candidate. Zero or unbounded capacities are rejected. Restart required.
rocm_graph_cache_entries.x-kiln-validation: 1..=64. Bounds retained native graph entries in every product and embedding constructor. At saturation, admission reclaims idle owners first and then the minimum fair-LRU active entries while preserving one graph per active owner after the incoming candidate. Zero or unbounded capacities are rejected. Restart required.

rocm_graph_cache_max_bytes.description: 67108864..=17179869184 (64 MiB through 16 GiB). Independently bounds requested physical bytes retained by graph-owned stable tensors, capture arenas, private-stream hipBLASLt workspaces, and owner slot state. Opaque HIP graph/exec/stream/event overhead is counted as objects and remains subject to live driver-pressure policy. Restart required.
rocm_graph_cache_max_bytes.x-kiln-validation: 67108864..=17179869184 (64 MiB through 16 GiB). Independently bounds requested physical bytes retained by graph-owned stable tensors, capture arenas, private-stream hipBLASLt workspaces, and owner slot state. Opaque HIP graph/exec/stream/event overhead is counted as objects and remains subject to live driver-pressure policy. Restart required.

batching.description: Production batching actor and direct-decode rendezvous policy.

mode.description: TOML accepts auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitively. Environment input also accepts the strict boolean spellings, mapping true to enabled and false to disabled. auto delegates actor selection to the immutable backend policy; an explicit value wins. Restart required.
mode.x-kiln-validation: TOML accepts auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitively. Environment input also accepts the strict boolean spellings, mapping true to enabled and false to disabled. auto delegates actor selection to the immutable backend policy; an explicit value wins. Restart required.

rowwise_decode.description: false sends each ready cohort through one true batched forward. true issues one forward per row while retaining actor ownership; it is an emergency correctness comparison, normally reduces throughput, and does not increase the effective decode width. Restart required.
rowwise_decode.x-kiln-validation: false sends each ready cohort through one true batched forward. true issues one forward per row while retaining actor ownership; it is an emergency correctness comparison, normally reduces throughput, and does not increase the effective decode width. Restart required.

prefix_aware_admission.description: When true, a queued same-adapter strict descendant waits while its active shorter prefix can become reusable; independent rows may still be admitted. Disable only for a controlled admission A/B. Restart required.
prefix_aware_admission.x-kiln-validation: When true, a queued same-adapter strict descendant waits while its active shorter prefix can become reusable; independent rows may still be admitted. Disable only for a controlled admission A/B. Restart required.

prefill_admission_quantum.description: An integer must be 1..=65536 and caps how many queued prompts the actor admits in one cycle before returning to decode. auto is case-insensitive and uses the backend policy below. The selected value is then clamped to 1..=effective max_decode_batch; the diagnostics name effective_decode_width as final authority when it performs that clamp. With non-burst admission, total active capacity is effective decode width plus this staging quantum, capped internally at four staging slots. The Strix Halo Vulkan development-soak candidate sets 2, admitting an equal pair while retaining a four-request active ceiling. Restart required.
prefill_admission_quantum.x-kiln-validation: An integer must be 1..=65536 and caps how many queued prompts the actor admits in one cycle before returning to decode. auto is case-insensitive and uses the backend policy below. The selected value is then clamped to 1..=effective max_decode_batch; the diagnostics name effective_decode_width as final authority when it performs that clamp. With non-burst admission, total active capacity is effective decode width plus this staging quantum, capped internally at four staging slots. The Strix Halo Vulkan development-soak candidate sets 2, admitting an equal pair while retaining a four-request active ceiling. Restart required.

direct_decode_rendezvous_mode.description: Selects only the fallback worker used by actor-absent direct streaming effectively-greedy requests. TOML accepts auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitively; environment input also accepts the strict boolean spellings. auto enables the worker on every real backend. Sampled requests, non-streaming requests, and every route using the batching actor bypass this worker. Restart required.
direct_decode_rendezvous_mode.x-kiln-validation: Selects only the fallback worker used by actor-absent direct streaming effectively-greedy requests. TOML accepts auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitively; environment input also accepts the strict boolean spellings. auto enables the worker on every real backend. Sampled requests, non-streaming requests, and every route using the batching actor bypass this worker. Restart required.

direct_decode_rendezvous_max_batch.description: An explicit integer must be 1..=65536. auto uses the backend policy below. Either selection is clamped to the already-resolved effective decode width; diagnostics use effective_decode_width when that ceiling wins. Restart required.
direct_decode_rendezvous_max_batch.x-kiln-validation: An explicit integer must be 1..=65536. auto uses the backend policy below. Either selection is clamped to the already-resolved effective decode width; diagnostics use effective_decode_width when that ceiling wins. Restart required.

direct_decode_rendezvous_wait_us.description: An explicit value is any non-negative u64 number of microseconds, including 0; auto uses backend policy. A negative, overflowing, malformed, or non-UTF-8 environment value stops startup. In particular, malformed legacy KILN_DECODE_BATCH_WAIT_US now fails startup instead of silently becoming zero. Restart required.
direct_decode_rendezvous_wait_us.x-kiln-validation: An explicit value is any non-negative u64 number of microseconds, including 0; auto uses backend policy. A negative, overflowing, malformed, or non-UTF-8 environment value stops startup. In particular, malformed legacy KILN_DECODE_BATCH_WAIT_US now fails startup instead of silently becoming zero. Restart required.

direct_decode_rendezvous_mixed_seq_lens.description: TOML accepts only the string auto or a native boolean; quoted boolean strings are rejected. Environment input accepts auto or the strict boolean spellings. The value controls whether one compatible fallback cohort may contain different decode positions. Restart required.
direct_decode_rendezvous_mixed_seq_lens.x-kiln-validation: TOML accepts only the string auto or a native boolean; quoted boolean strings are rejected. Environment input accepts auto or the strict boolean spellings. The value controls whether one compatible fallback cohort may contain different decode positions. Restart required.

model.description: Model, tokenizer, snapshot, adapter, and served identity paths.

path.description: Must be non-empty when set. Omitted starts the server in mock mode; a real model path enables real inference.
path.x-kiln-validation: Must be non-empty when set. Omitted starts the server in mock mode; a real model path enables real inference.

model_id.description: Must be non-empty. Used for model/tokenizer identity and as the source of the default served id. Kiln still applies its built-in Qwen3.5-4B runtime profile.
model_id.x-kiln-validation: Must be non-empty. Used for model/tokenizer identity and as the source of the default served id. Kiln still applies its built-in Qwen3.5-4B runtime profile.

adapter_dir.description: Must be non-empty when set. For the Qwen3.5-4B profile, omission resolves to <model.path>/adapters.
adapter_dir.x-kiln-validation: Must be non-empty when set. For the Qwen3.5-4B profile, omission resolves to <model.path>/adapters.

snapshot_dir.description: Must be non-empty when set. The environment alias uniquely treats an empty or whitespace-only value as a request to clear the TOML value. Without a value, Kiln tries a location beside the model and then the system temporary directory.
snapshot_dir.x-kiln-validation: Must be non-empty when set. The environment alias uniquely treats an empty or whitespace-only value as a request to clear the TOML value. Without a value, Kiln tries a location beside the model and then the system temporary directory.

vulkan_decode_weight_prewarm.description: Populates backend-private Vulkan decode-weight caches during startup. Disable only to trade first-request latency for lower startup work. Restart required.
vulkan_decode_weight_prewarm.x-kiln-validation: Populates backend-private Vulkan decode-weight caches during startup. Disable only to trade first-request latency for lower startup work. Restart required.

vulkan_decode_weight_prewarm_mib_per_sec.description: 1..=16384. Bounds the average Vulkan decode-weight cache materialization rate. Pacing checks shutdown at least every 25 ms between uploads. Restart required.
vulkan_decode_weight_prewarm_mib_per_sec.x-kiln-validation: 1..=16384. Bounds the average Vulkan decode-weight cache materialization rate. Pacing checks shutdown at least every 25 ms between uploads. Restart required.

served_model_id.description: Must be non-empty when set. Otherwise the effective id is the final slash-separated component of model.model_id (Qwen3.5-4B by default). serve --served-model-id applies a typed, validated override after environment resolution.
served_model_id.x-kiln-validation: Must be non-empty when set. Otherwise the effective id is the final slash-separated component of model.model_id (Qwen3.5-4B by default). serve --served-model-id applies a typed, validated override after environment resolution.

memory.description: Accelerator capacity, live-governor, KV-cache, and graph allocation policy.

num_blocks.description: Must be greater than zero when set. Omission invokes backend-aware automatic KV-block sizing.
num_blocks.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero when set. Omission invokes backend-aware automatic KV-block sizing.

gpu_memory_gb.description: Must be finite, greater than zero, and representable as bytes. Units are GiB. This is a capacity cap, not a hardware override: it may reduce the detected safe capacity but never expands physical VRAM, host-backed unified memory, or a cgroup-bounded capacity. A request above the safe detected capacity is clamped down.
gpu_memory_gb.x-kiln-validation: Must be finite, greater than zero, and representable as bytes. Units are GiB. This is a capacity cap, not a hardware override: it may reduce the detected safe capacity but never expands physical VRAM, host-backed unified memory, or a cgroup-bounded capacity. A request above the safe detected capacity is clamped down.

inference_memory_fraction.description: Loader validation accepts 0.0..=1.0; real-state construction clamps the configured value to 0.1..=1.0 before KV sizing. The remainder is available to the training budget.
inference_memory_fraction.x-kiln-validation: Loader validation accepts 0.0..=1.0; real-state construction clamps the configured value to 0.1..=1.0 before KV sizing. The remainder is available to the training budget.

training_memory_gb.description: Must be finite, greater than zero, and representable as bytes when set. Optional training-budget cap in GiB; it can reduce but never expand the capacity remaining after resident model and KV allocations.
training_memory_gb.x-kiln-validation: Must be finite, greater than zero, and representable as bytes when set. Optional training-budget cap in GiB; it can reduce but never expand the capacity remaining after resident model and KV allocations.

vulkan_buffer_pool_gb.description: Vulkan-only process-wide cap, in GiB, on idle scratch buffers retained for reuse. Must be finite, non-negative, and representable as bytes; 0 disables retention. Active operations may allocate beyond the cap, but overflow buffers are freed when their final caller drops. A new cache entry evicts the oldest idle buffers before admission, and pressure reclaim releases idle entries under exclusive GPU coordination. /v1/config, /health, and Prometheus expose the cap, retained/free/borrowed bytes, hits/misses by allocation route, evictions, and uncached overflow. Health also exposes one bounded last-miss record with requested and bucket bytes plus the source callsite. The default remains 3.0; the Strix Halo Vulkan development-soak candidate explicitly sets 3.5 after the smaller cap showed deterministic eviction churn.
vulkan_buffer_pool_gb.x-kiln-validation: Vulkan-only process-wide cap, in GiB, on idle scratch buffers retained for reuse. Must be finite, non-negative, and representable as bytes; 0 disables retention. Active operations may allocate beyond the cap, but overflow buffers are freed when their final caller drops. A new cache entry evicts the oldest idle buffers before admission, and pressure reclaim releases idle entries under exclusive GPU coordination. /v1/config, /health, and Prometheus expose the cap, retained/free/borrowed bytes, hits/misses by allocation route, evictions, and uncached overflow. Health also exposes one bounded last-miss record with requested and bucket bytes plus the source callsite. The default remains 3.0; the Strix Halo Vulkan development-soak candidate explicitly sets 3.5 after the smaller cap showed deterministic eviction churn.

floor_gb.description: Must be finite, non-negative, representable as bytes, and strictly smaller than the selected accelerator's effective capacity after memory.gpu_memory_gb is applied. Units are GiB. Accelerator startup rejects an equal or larger floor before model upload and reports both configured and effective byte values. The process-wide governor subtracts this additional floor, then outstanding soft reservations, from live free memory when computing allocation headroom. On unified-memory devices it is separate from the physical-memory reserve applied during safe-capacity detection.
floor_gb.x-kiln-validation: Must be finite, non-negative, representable as bytes, and strictly smaller than the selected accelerator's effective capacity after memory.gpu_memory_gb is applied. Units are GiB. Accelerator startup rejects an equal or larger floor before model upload and reports both configured and effective byte values. The process-wide governor subtracts this additional floor, then outstanding soft reservations, from live free memory when computing allocation headroom. On unified-memory devices it is separate from the physical-memory reserve applied during safe-capacity detection.

probe_ms.description: Must be greater than zero. Sets the background memory-sampler cadence. Request, inference, health, and metrics paths read only the published sample and never run a driver/OS probe synchronously. Cached admission fails closed when the sample is older than max(5000 ms, 4 * probe_ms), the latest probe failed, or a required sampler is not running. An explicit refresh after a material allocation or release bypasses the cadence.
probe_ms.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. Sets the background memory-sampler cadence. Request, inference, health, and metrics paths read only the published sample and never run a driver/OS probe synchronously. Cached admission fails closed when the sample is older than max(5000 ms, 4 * probe_ms), the latest probe failed, or a required sampler is not running. An explicit refresh after a material allocation or release bypasses the cadence.

reclaim_mode.description: Exactly off, on-demand, or automatic, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. off prevents execution of registered allocator reclaim hooks; on-demand permits explicit pressure and allocation-retry reclaim calls; automatic also permits the background pressure monitor. The immutable serving profile remains authoritative: a profile with allocator reclaim disabled keeps the effective mode off and does not start the monitor.
reclaim_mode.x-kiln-validation: Exactly off, on-demand, or automatic, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. off prevents execution of registered allocator reclaim hooks; on-demand permits explicit pressure and allocation-retry reclaim calls; automatic also permits the background pressure monitor. The immutable serving profile remains authoritative: a profile with allocator reclaim disabled keeps the effective mode off and does not start the monitor.

kv_autoscale.description: Requests the pressure-driven physical KV-cache control loop. The serving profile and backend remain authoritative: stable mode and backends without device-resident KV pressure report the request as unavailable rather than silently enabling mutation. /health, /v1/config, and the trusted debug state expose the request, effective state, bounded reason, and source.
kv_autoscale.x-kiln-validation: Requests the pressure-driven physical KV-cache control loop. The serving profile and backend remain authoritative: stable mode and backends without device-resident KV pressure report the request as unavailable rather than silently enabling mutation. /health, /v1/config, and the trusted debug state expose the request, effective state, bounded reason, and source.

kv_force_blocks.description: A positive value requests one exact startup resize before the normal autoscaler loop. It requires memory.kv_autoscale=true and server.serving_profile="maintenance"; every other combination fails configuration validation. Zero disables the one-shot operation. The resize still uses full replacement-pool reservation, exclusive GPU ownership, graph invalidation, transactional publication, and typed forced_configuration attribution. This is an offline maintenance/qualification control, not a per-request tuning knob.
kv_force_blocks.x-kiln-validation: A positive value requests one exact startup resize before the normal autoscaler loop. It requires memory.kv_autoscale=true and server.serving_profile="maintenance"; every other combination fails configuration validation. Zero disables the one-shot operation. The resize still uses full replacement-pool reservation, exclusive GPU ownership, graph invalidation, transactional publication, and typed forced_configuration attribution. This is an offline maintenance/qualification control, not a per-request tuning knob.

kv_cache_fp8.description: Requests E4M3FN KV storage. Backend storage policy may reject or disable the request when unsupported.
kv_cache_fp8.x-kiln-validation: Requests E4M3FN KV storage. Backend storage policy may reject or disable the request when unsupported.

cuda_graphs.description: CUDA-only request. Non-CUDA backends ignore it, and a serving profile with live graph capture disabled selects eager-only execution regardless of this value.
cuda_graphs.x-kiln-validation: CUDA-only request. Non-CUDA backends ignore it, and a serving profile with live graph capture disabled selects eager-only execution regardless of this value.

training.description: Native training checkpoint, queue, retention, and webhook policy.

grad_checkpoint_segments.description: Must be greater than zero when set. When present, selects an explicit process-lifetime gradient-checkpoint segment count for native training; omission leaves workload- and capacity-aware automatic planning enabled.
grad_checkpoint_segments.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero when set. When present, selects an explicit process-lifetime gradient-checkpoint segment count for native training; omission leaves workload- and capacity-aware automatic planning enabled.

no_grad_checkpoint.description: Disables gradient checkpoint execution for native training. The disabled state and any explicit segment count are retained together in the immutable training policy and exact-resume identity. Disabling checkpointing can materially increase training memory.
no_grad_checkpoint.x-kiln-validation: Disables gradient checkpoint execution for native training. The disabled state and any explicit segment count are retained together in the immutable training policy and exact-resume identity. Disabling checkpointing can materially increase training memory.

recompute_checkpoint_boundaries.description: auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. auto replays sparse SFT boundaries when sequence length is at least recompute_boundary_threshold_tokens; enabled always replays them and disabled always retains them. The canonical environment name accepts only those three words. The deprecated alias additionally accepts historical 1/true/yes and 0/false/no; on and off are not accepted for this alias.
recompute_checkpoint_boundaries.x-kiln-validation: auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. auto replays sparse SFT boundaries when sequence length is at least recompute_boundary_threshold_tokens; enabled always replays them and disabled always retains them. The canonical environment name accepts only those three words. The deprecated alias additionally accepts historical 1/true/yes and 0/false/no; on and off are not accepted for this alias.

recompute_boundary_threshold_tokens.description: Inclusive sequence-length threshold used only by automatic SFT boundary replay. Zero, negative, overflowing, malformed, and non-UTF-8 environment values stop startup.
recompute_boundary_threshold_tokens.x-kiln-validation: Inclusive sequence-length threshold used only by automatic SFT boundary replay. Zero, negative, overflowing, malformed, and non-UTF-8 environment values stop startup.

checkpoint_boundary_anchor_stride.description: When sparse SFT replay is active, a concrete value retains every Nth segment boundary as an anchor. auto derives a shape-specific positive stride from sequence length, segment count, hidden width, boundary dtype, and the cache target. Zero and strings other than auto fail startup.
checkpoint_boundary_anchor_stride.x-kiln-validation: When sparse SFT replay is active, a concrete value retains every Nth segment boundary as an anchor. auto derives a shape-specific positive stride from sequence length, segment count, hidden width, boundary dtype, and the cache target. Zero and strings other than auto fail startup.

checkpoint_boundary_cache_gb.description: Automatic anchor-stride memory target. Despite the historical _gb spelling, the unit is GiB (2^30 bytes). The value must be finite, positive, convert to at least one byte, and remain below the u64 byte limit. Startup converts it once to integral bytes using the historical truncating conversion.
checkpoint_boundary_cache_gb.x-kiln-validation: Automatic anchor-stride memory target. Despite the historical _gb spelling, the unit is GiB (2^30 bytes). The value must be finite, positive, convert to at least one byte, and remain below the u64 byte limit. Startup converts it once to integral bytes using the historical truncating conversion.

checkpoint_interval.description: Must be greater than zero when set. Number of committed optimizer steps between checkpoints; per-job configuration overrides it. Omission disables periodic checkpoints.
checkpoint_interval.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero when set. Number of committed optimizer steps between checkpoints; per-job configuration overrides it. Omission disables periodic checkpoints.

webhook_url.description: Must be a non-empty valid HTTP(S) URL. An exactly empty environment value clears a TOML URL; whitespace is not a clearing value and fails validation. Delivery is fire-and-forget with a five-second timeout after terminal state is recorded.
webhook_url.x-kiln-validation: Must be a non-empty valid HTTP(S) URL. An exactly empty environment value clears a TOML URL; whitespace is not a clearing value and fails validation. Delivery is fire-and-forget with a five-second timeout after terminal state is recorded.

logit_cache_dir.description: Optional teacher-logit cache root. Relative paths are resolved once against the startup working directory. Omission places logit-cache beside the effective adapter directory.
logit_cache_dir.x-kiln-type-and-default: optional path string; omitted (beside the effective adapter directory)
logit_cache_dir.x-kiln-validation: Must be a non-empty path when set. Resolved once at startup; request handlers never reread the environment.

max_queued_jobs.description: Must be greater than zero. At capacity, submissions return HTTP 503 with Retry-After: 30.
max_queued_jobs.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. At capacity, submissions return HTTP 503 with Retry-After: 30.

max_tracked_jobs.description: Must be greater than zero and at least max_queued_jobs. Counts queued, running, completed, and failed entries.
max_tracked_jobs.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero and at least max_queued_jobs. Counts queued, running, completed, and failed entries.

tracked_job_ttl_secs.description: Must be greater than zero. Terminal entries older than the TTL are removed; active jobs are never age-evicted.
tracked_job_ttl_secs.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. Terminal entries older than the TTL are removed; active jobs are never age-evicted.

level.description: One of trace, debug, info, warn, error, or a valid tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter directive such as kiln=debug,tower_http=warn. RUST_LOG overrides the effective filter but does not make an invalid typed value valid.
level.x-kiln-validation: One of trace, debug, info, warn, error, or a valid tracing_subscriber::EnvFilter directive such as kiln=debug,tower_http=warn. RUST_LOG overrides the effective filter but does not make an invalid typed value valid.

format.description: Exactly auto, json, pretty, text, or human. auto is pretty on a stderr TTY and JSON otherwise; text and human select pretty output.
format.x-kiln-validation: Exactly auto, json, pretty, text, or human. auto is pretty on a stderr TTY and JSON otherwise; text and human select pretty output.

prefix_cache.description: Requested shared-prefix KV and recurrent-state retention policy. Backend qualification determines the effective capability.

enabled.description: Requests reuse of KV blocks and recurrent-state snapshots for shared prompt prefixes. CPU, CUDA, ROCm, and Metal honor the request. Vulkan currently forces the effective capability off because repeated production-model runs proved semantic corruption after cross-request restoration. This is a source-level correctness quarantine, not a second setting.
enabled.x-kiln-validation: Requests reuse of KV blocks and recurrent-state snapshots for shared prompt prefixes. CPU, CUDA, ROCm, and Metal honor the request. Vulkan currently forces the effective capability off because repeated production-model runs proved semantic corruption after cross-request restoration. This is a source-level correctness quarantine, not a second setting.

max_blocks.description: Must be greater than zero when set. On an admitted backend, None resolves to half of the allocated KV block pool. It has no runtime allocation effect while the effective capability is off.
max_blocks.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero when set. On an admitted backend, None resolves to half of the allocated KV block pool. It has no runtime allocation effect while the effective capability is off.

max_entries.description: Must be greater than zero when set. On an admitted backend, None resolves from the relevant safe allocation tier and per-entry recurrent-state bytes, with at least one entry. It has no runtime allocation effect while the effective capability is off; quarantined Vulkan reserves no host-backed prefix state.
max_entries.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero when set. On an admitted backend, None resolves from the relevant safe allocation tier and per-entry recurrent-state bytes, with at least one entry. It has no runtime allocation effect while the effective capability is off; quarantined Vulkan reserves no host-backed prefix state.

enabled.description: false forces the effective method to off. For compatibility, true with method = "off" selects skip_layer; that effective method is then subject to the fail-closed startup gate below.
enabled.x-kiln-validation: false forces the effective method to off. For compatibility, true with method = "off" selects skip_layer; that effective method is then subject to the fail-closed startup gate below.

method.description: TOML accepts off, skip_layer, or mtp. The environment parser also accepts none, 0, false; skiplayer, skip-layer, self; and native_mtp, native-mtp. The deprecated method alias also controls enabled when neither enabled spelling is present: non-off enables and off disables. The canonical method name has literal field semantics and does not implicitly enable.
method.x-kiln-validation: TOML accepts off, skip_layer, or mtp. The environment parser also accepts none, 0, false; skiplayer, skip-layer, self; and native_mtp, native-mtp. The deprecated method alias also controls enabled when neither enabled spelling is present: non-off enables and off disables. The canonical method name has literal field semantics and does not implicitly enable.

num_speculative_tokens.description: Draft proposal bound K. Must be in 1..=4; out-of-range values stop startup before accelerator allocation. This conservative ceiling matches the planned local K=1/2/4 qualification matrix and cannot be raised without new accelerator evidence.
num_speculative_tokens.x-kiln-validation: Draft proposal bound K. Must be in 1..=4; out-of-range values stop startup before accelerator allocation. This conservative ceiling matches the planned local K=1/2/4 qualification matrix and cannot be raised without new accelerator evidence.

draft_layers.description: Must be greater than zero. When speculative decoding is enabled, model-dependent startup validation also requires this value to be less than the selected model's transformer-layer count. Invalid geometry stops startup; it does not fall back at request time.
draft_layers.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. When speculative decoding is enabled, model-dependent startup validation also requires this value to be less than the selected model's transformer-layer count. Invalid geometry stops startup; it does not fall back at request time.

streaming_prefill.description: Backend-aware streaming-prefill dispatch and tile policy.

mode.description: auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. auto delegates dispatch to backend policy, enabled selects every non-empty prompt, and disabled selects none. The canonical environment name accepts only those three words. Deprecated aliases also accept the strict boolean forms listed above, mapping true to enabled and false to disabled. Legacy TOML enabled = true or enabled = false remains accepted; if mode is also present, both must express the same non-auto intent or startup fails.
mode.x-kiln-validation: auto, enabled, or disabled, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. auto delegates dispatch to backend policy, enabled selects every non-empty prompt, and disabled selects none. The canonical environment name accepts only those three words. Deprecated aliases also accept the strict boolean forms listed above, mapping true to enabled and false to disabled. Legacy TOML enabled = true or enabled = false remains accepted; if mode is also present, both must express the same non-auto intent or startup fails.

threshold_tokens.description: In auto mode, an integer replaces the backend crossover only when that backend already has a threshold-based automatic policy. It does not make CPU or Vulkan auto-dispatch streaming. 0, negative values, and strings other than auto fail startup. enabled and disabled modes ignore this crossover for dispatch while retaining it in diagnostics.
threshold_tokens.x-kiln-validation: In auto mode, an integer replaces the backend crossover only when that backend already has a threshold-based automatic policy. It does not make CPU or Vulkan auto-dispatch streaming. 0, negative values, and strings other than auto fail startup. enabled and disabled modes ignore this crossover for dispatch while retaining it in diagnostics.

tile_tokens.description: Base tile for ordinary tiled prefill and non-tape GDN segment execution. Concrete values must be positive multiples of 64. When this field is concrete and either specialized tile below is auto, that specialized route inherits this base value rather than its backend default.
tile_tokens.x-kiln-validation: Base tile for ordinary tiled prefill and non-tape GDN segment execution. Concrete values must be positive multiples of 64. When this field is concrete and either specialized tile below is auto, that specialized route inherits this base value rather than its backend default.

tape_tile_tokens.description: Tile used by tape-authoritative training forward paths. Concrete values must be positive multiples of 64. auto inherits an explicit tile_tokens; when both are auto, backend policy owns the value.
tape_tile_tokens.x-kiln-validation: Tile used by tape-authoritative training forward paths. Concrete values must be positive multiples of 64. auto inherits an explicit tile_tokens; when both are auto, backend policy owns the value.

detached_full_attn_tile_tokens.description: Tile for detached materialized full-attention training work. A concrete value also controls its derived boundary-forward and tape-replay variants. auto inherits an explicit tile_tokens; when both are auto, each variant keeps its backend default. Every concrete value must be a positive multiple of 64.
detached_full_attn_tile_tokens.x-kiln-validation: Tile for detached materialized full-attention training work. A concrete value also controls its derived boundary-forward and tape-replay variants. auto inherits an explicit tile_tokens; when both are auto, each variant keeps its backend default. Every concrete value must be a positive multiple of 64.

last_token_lm_head.description: When true, the final inference streaming tile computes the LM head only for its last row. All centralized strict boolean spellings, including on and off, work identically.
last_token_lm_head.x-kiln-validation: When true, the final inference streaming tile computes the LM head only for its last row. All centralized strict boolean spellings, including on and off, work identically.

enabled.description: Deprecated TOML compatibility input. Use streaming_prefill.mode; when both are present they must express the same non-auto intent.
enabled.x-kiln-validation: Deprecated TOML compatibility input. Maps true to enabled and false to disabled. Conflicts with an explicit mode stop startup.

adapters.description: Finalized adapter and composed-cache disk limits.

library_url.description: HTTP(S) adapter-library endpoint returned by the library API. The endpoint remains contract-only until the remote library backend launches.
library_url.x-kiln-validation: Must be a non-empty valid HTTP(S) URL. Resolved once at startup.

max_disk_bytes.description: Caps finalized adapter bytes under adapter_dir, excluding upload staging and the composed cache. For the environment alias only, empty or 0 means None and disables the cap. TOML 0 is accepted as a literal zero cap, not as None.
max_disk_bytes.x-kiln-validation: Caps finalized adapter bytes under adapter_dir, excluding upload staging and the composed cache. For the environment alias only, empty or 0 means None and disables the cap. TOML 0 is accepted as a literal zero cap, not as None.

composed_cache_max_bytes.description: LRU byte cap for .composed. Environment empty or 0 disables this dimension; TOML 0 remains a zero cap.
composed_cache_max_bytes.x-kiln-validation: LRU byte cap for .composed. Environment empty or 0 disables this dimension; TOML 0 remains a zero cap.

composed_cache_max_entries.description: LRU entry-count cap for .composed. Environment empty or 0 disables this dimension; TOML 0 remains a zero cap.
composed_cache_max_entries.x-kiln-validation: LRU entry-count cap for .composed. Environment empty or 0 disables this dimension; TOML 0 remains a zero cap.

eval.description: Evaluation registry, queue, retention, and webhook policy.

eval_dir.description: Must be non-empty when set. Despite the historical field name, runtime treats it as the shared eval root and creates the three registry subdirectories below it.
eval_dir.x-kiln-validation: Must be non-empty when set. Despite the historical field name, runtime treats it as the shared eval root and creates the three registry subdirectories below it.

max_tracked_jobs.description: Must be greater than zero and at least max_queued_jobs.
max_tracked_jobs.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero and at least max_queued_jobs.

webhook_url.description: Must be a non-empty valid HTTP(S) URL. Terminal eval notifications are fire-and-forget.
webhook_url.x-kiln-validation: Must be a non-empty valid HTTP(S) URL. Terminal eval notifications are fire-and-forget.

enabled.description: Master switch. Initialization failure logs a warning and disables logging rather than aborting an otherwise valid server startup.
enabled.x-kiln-validation: Master switch. Initialization failure logs a warning and disables logging rather than aborting an otherwise valid server startup.

dir.description: Must be non-empty when set. None resolves to <adapter_dir>/.requests. The environment alias cannot clear a TOML directory; an empty value is fatal.
dir.x-kiln-validation: Must be non-empty when set. None resolves to <adapter_dir>/.requests. The environment alias cannot clear a TOML directory; an empty value is fatal.

max_file_bytes.description: Must be at least 4096. The active JSONL file rotates after reaching the threshold.
max_file_bytes.x-kiln-validation: Must be at least 4096. The active JSONL file rotates after reaching the threshold.

max_total_bytes.description: Must be greater than zero. Oldest rotated files are removed until retained bytes fit. There is no validation requiring this value to exceed max_file_bytes.
max_total_bytes.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. Oldest rotated files are removed until retained bytes fit. There is no validation requiring this value to exceed max_file_bytes.

max_capture_bytes.description: Must be greater than zero. Per-request and per-response storage cap; truncation affects the log only, never the wire response.
max_capture_bytes.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. Per-request and per-response storage cap; truncation affects the log only, never the wire response.

agent.description: Self-improvement schedule, embedded agent-run limits, and immutable pi runtime policy.

self_improve_interval_hours.description: Omission disables scheduling. 0 is accepted and also results in no scheduler. The first run occurs one full interval after startup; cadence is persisted under the adapter directory.
self_improve_interval_hours.x-kiln-validation: Omission disables scheduling. 0 is accepted and also results in no scheduler. The first run occurs one full interval after startup; cadence is persisted under the adapter directory.

self_improve.description: Request template submitted to the same self-improvement path as the API. This value is intentionally open structured data; its inner request contract is validated by that subsystem rather than by KilnConfig.
self_improve.x-kiln-validation: Request template submitted to the same self-improvement path as the API. This value is intentionally open structured data; its inner request contract is validated by that subsystem rather than by KilnConfig.

max_concurrent_runs.description: Must be greater than zero. Embedded pi runs above the limit queue FIFO.
max_concurrent_runs.x-kiln-validation: Must be greater than zero. Embedded pi runs above the limit queue FIFO.

run_timeout_secs.description: Must be at least 10. A per-run timeout can override the server default.
run_timeout_secs.x-kiln-validation: Must be at least 10. A per-run timeout can override the server default.

runs_access.description: Process-lifetime access policy for embedded pi runs and their prompt, event, steering, and abort APIs. loopback_only enables them only for localhost or a loopback IP bind.
runs_access.x-kiln-environment: KILN_AGENT_RUNS (deprecated compatibility; boolean spellings map to enabled/disabled)
runs_access.x-kiln-validation: loopback_only, enabled, or disabled. Compatibility boolean spellings are accepted from the environment. Embedded runs can execute arbitrary code; changing this requires restart.

pi_bin.description: Optional explicit pi executable. Omission searches the startup PATH once. Relative paths are resolved against the startup working directory.
pi_bin.x-kiln-type-and-default: optional path string; omitted (search startup PATH)
pi_bin.x-kiln-validation: Must name a non-empty existing file when explicitly configured. The resolved executable is immutable for the process lifetime.

pi_sessions_dir.description: Optional external pi session root used for trace discovery. Omission resolves $HOME/.pi/agent/sessions once at startup, with /tmp/pi/agent/sessions as the no-HOME fallback.
pi_sessions_dir.x-kiln-validation: Must be a non-empty path when set. Relative paths and the HOME fallback are resolved once at startup.

origin.description: Must be the exact canonical scheme://host[:port] origin, with no path, query, fragment, or embedded credentials. HTTPS is required unless the host is loopback.
origin.x-kiln-type-and-default: required string for each entry; no entries by default
origin.x-kiln-canonical-env: none; structured trust policy is TOML-only
origin.x-kiln-validation: Must be the exact canonical scheme://host[:port] origin, with no path, query, fragment, or embedded credentials. HTTPS is required unless the host is loopback.

api_key_env.description: Must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, length 1..=128. The named variable must exist and contain a non-whitespace value at startup.
api_key_env.x-kiln-canonical-env: none; this value names the secret variable
api_key_env.x-kiln-validation: Must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, length 1..=128. The named variable must exist and contain a non-whitespace value at startup.

teachers.description: Server-owned remote-teacher credential handles and authorized origins.

credentials.description: Opaque credential handles mapped to one exact authorized origin and one secret environment-variable name.
